note: H197: string-hash randomisation reaching a published commitment.

controls.name: C1_probe_sees_stability
controls.must_fire_because: at least one measured spike must come out STABLE, or the probe is calling everything unstable
controls.can_fail_because: a probe comparing timestamps as hashes would report every spike unstable and distinguish nothing

controls.name: C2_hashes_were_found
controls.must_fire_because: a probe that found no 64-hex values would report perfect stability
controls.can_fail_because: a wrong artifact filename yields an empty hash set and a vacuous green

falsifiers.name: F1_not_hash_order
falsifiers.null_must_contain: an unstable hash that survives PYTHONHASHSEED=0
falsifiers.refutes: that string-hash randomisation is the cause
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F2_only_one_spike
falsifiers.can_fail_because: exactly one measured spike publishes an unstable hash
falsifiers.refutes: that this is a CLASS rather than one spike's defect
falsifiers.fires_when: exactly one measured spike publishes an unstable hash
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifier: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 does not stabilise the hashes, or only one spike varies
